title: Fix Common AI HITL review write endpoints forbidden errors
body:
The three HITL write endpoints (`/sessions/feedback`, `/sessions/approve`,
`/sessions/reject`) were using `requires_access_dag(method="POST", ...)` for
their authorization check.

The FAB auth manager maps HTTP methods to FAB permission actions:

| HTTP method | FAB permission |
|-------------|----------------|
| `GET`       | `can_read`     |
| `POST`      | `can_create`   |
| `PUT`       | `can_edit`     |

However, `RESOURCE_HITL_DETAIL` is only ever granted `can_read` (Viewer
role) and `can_edit` (User role) — `can_create` is never registered for
this resource. 

This meant that every call to the write endpoints was evaluated as
`("can_create", "HITL Detail") in user_permissions`, which is always
`False`
